$comment: NEW FILE. Rule 2 permits unverified figures to render; the editorial policy in CLAUDE.md narrows where. This file is that policy in machine-readable form, so it is enforced by CI rather than remembered by whoever writes the next component. Changing what the public sees is a deliberate edit here, reviewable in a diff — never a special case inside a template.

renderable_status.$comment: Statuses that may appear on the public site at all. draft is incomplete work; withdrawn is retracted without a replacement. Neither belongs in front of a reader. superseded appears only on the history route, which is why it is listed separately.

by_subject_type.$comment: Overrides keyed by the subject entity's type. A machine-extracted financial or criminal figure attached to a living person is the one case where being wrong causes harm a label does not undo, and it carries real defamation exposure in India. Aggregate indicators about a place carry no such risk: a GDP series with three unchecked years is still useful, and the label is honest.

person.reason: Claims about a named individual render only when a person has checked them against the page.

status_label_required_adjacent.$comment: Rule 2: a reader who never opens a provenance panel must still know what they are looking at. These statuses must have their name rendered as text next to the value itself — not only inside the expandable panel, and never by colour alone.
